gen-dafont-franchise-gf-noto-serif-vithk: Franchise crowds its tubular, wire-like letters tightly together, with small letters so tall the ascenders barely rise above them. Noto Serif Vithkuqi flows gently, round bowls and finer crossbars carrying the eye.
gen-dafont-gobold-gf-abyssinica-sil: Spread out and stubbornly unclosed, Gobold joins its strokes without thinning them anywhere. And Abyssinica SIL settles into a tall middle zone and a soft, watercolor-like shift in line weight.
gen-dafont-gobold-gf-cambo: Cambo narrows gradually from stem to terminal, its lowercase sitting only a short step below the capitals. While Gobold hits hardest in stout, pipe-cleaner strokes, Cambo is happiest in refined, bookish lines.
gen-dafont-gobold-gf-noto-serif-ahom: Gobold draws every curve as a monoline stroke that refuses to close, with letters spread far apart along the line. Noto Serif Ahom then adds lofty, dignified letters with subtle contrast.
gen-dafont-gobold-gf-noto-serif-kannada: Commanding and geometric, Gobold spaces its letters far apart. Giving Gobold plenty of size and Noto Serif Kannada a modest one lets its big counters and soft heavier accents breathe.
gen-dafont-gobold-gf-noto-serif-khmer: Gobold draws a single unmodulated line across every glyph, without any swelling. Gobold's job is blunt, geometric force, while Noto Serif Khmer excels at authoritative, modest hairline thinning on its curves.
gen-dafont-groovy-gf-almendra: Funky and friendly, Groovy leaves a narrow slit where its c nearly closes, with arms and legs of constant width. Almendra adds a touch of stroke contrast where Groovy has none, which is the whole charm.
gen-dafont-groovy-gf-bree-serif: Friendly to the core, Groovy cuts each stroke at a single engraver's depth, never deeper in places. While Groovy handles the funk, Bree Serif's outsized lowercase does the refined, literary talking.
gen-dafont-impact-label-gf-almendra: Heavy and commanding, Impact Label strings each letter apart like a bead on a rod. But shrink Impact Label and its punch fades, or enlarge Almendra and its dignified, deep-bodied lowercase turns loud.
gen-dafont-impact-label-gf-bree-serif: Impact Label stands each letter apart, like beads on a rod. Bree Serif, by contrast, reads with literary refinement, its outsized lowercase filling each line generously as the paragraphs run on.
